title: Shutting down our public encrypted DNS
summary: Mullvad, a privacy-focused VPN provider, announced they are shutting down their public encrypted DNS servers and instead sponsoring Quad9, a nonprofit privacy-focused DNS service. The decision was made to focus resources on their core VPN business while supporting an established, independent DNS provider that aligns with their privacy mission.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of maintaining a public DNS service that diverts resources from core business while still providing privacy-respecting DNS options to users.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how companies can strategically redirect resources by partnering with specialized providers, promoting a healthier privacy ecosystem rather than fragmenting efforts.
